negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, smooth CGI skin, hyperrealistic human pores, plastic doll sheen, cartoon illustration, aggressive harsh shadows, cold fluorescent lighting, modern digital devices
reconstruction_priority: Puppet face craftsmanship — AI often replaces sculpted clay planes with either generic cartoon dolls or overly wrinkled CGI human skin
Tactile tweed and wool textures — AI frequently blurs fabric weaves into smooth flat digital paint
Steaming teacup and teapot interaction — AI struggles with physically coherent steam and proper hand grips on miniature handles
Vintage radio and glowing bulb detail — AI tends to hallucinate generic plastic boomboxes instead of authentic timber tube radios with illuminated filaments
